rows.en: Touya: "You've got to be kidding... Ymir's been kidnapped...?"
Fain: "Heh... That's right. This is more like you.
Don't run away. Face reality properly."
Emy: "Wh-What?! You don't have to tell me...
I was just a little surprised!"
Emy: "Could it be... for my sake?"
If Ymir isn't around, I can't call you Second."
You think so? Aw, you're embarrassing me!"
Ai: "...So, how do you plan to find her?"
Ai: "Don't tell me you haven't thought of anything?!"
Fain: "W-Well, with hard work and guts..."
Ai: "No way. I can't believe it!"
Touya: "I was starting to think a little better of you..."
Celica: "Oh, but we'll know where Ymir is right away."
Celica: "Actually, I secretly put a transmitter on her."
Touya: "A transmitter... How does your mind work...?"
Celica: "I thought something like this might happen.
Hehe. I've always wanted to say that."
Touya: "...You haven't put them on us too, have you?"
Xiujian: "...That is an invasion of privacy.
It has been useful this time, but I would like you
to refrain from such behavior in the future."
Arthur: "In that case, let us leave at once.
We do not know the enemy's objective, and there is no guarantee that Ymir
I'll never forgive you if you don't bring her back safely!"
Bernst: "Oh? I do not see Lyle anywhere."
Debish: "Who knows? He is probably asleep in his room.
He sulks as soon as he cannot have his way...
And at the same time, someone you know."
Debish: "Hehehe. Perhaps I should call you Clasio?
That is what I always called you, after all."
Debish: "Still do not recognize me? Let me see.
The man who helped you repair the headmaster's vase you broke...
Would that tell you who I am?"
Debish: "Yes. He is me, and I am him.
Our existence is now one and the same. I believe
it was called the 'Third Law of Self-Deconstruction and Transformation'?
In any case, thanks to your help, his research has borne fruit.
Debish: "He wanted to prove his own theory.
Even if it meant losing his own mind.
Unbound by status or fame... He was a true seeker,
Debish: "You understand, but your heart refuses to accept it.
Is that it? Well, I am here.
That is the one and only fact.
More importantly, are you not concerned for yourself?"
To you, this is 'enemy territory,' after all.
Ymir: "...And then use me as a shield
But I only want him to come here. Without fail.
Doris: "What?! Can't you be quiet for a moment?"
Doris: "Wh-Why bring that up all of a sudden...?"
Resh: "I just can't think of that man as Dei.
No, he isn't Dei, so of course I can't...
Argh, I can't explain it properly,
but I don't feel like following him.
You feel the same way, don't you?"
Doris: "...Then what exactly do you intend to do?"
Doris: "Unfortunately, now that Ioannis is dead
and our ties to both Zigrim and Bio have been cut,
we no longer have the strength to act independently.
Besides... That man is Dei. No, Dei was that man."
Doris: "I understand now. The Dei I loved was him.
Those eyes filled with such hopelessly deep loneliness...
I fell in love with him inside Dei."
Resh: "That can't be. I thought... I thought
Ever since I first met you that day, three years ago..."
Resh: "I-I've watched you far more than that man has.
I care about you more than he does!
Doris: "Resh... I'm happy you feel that way.
But it has to be him.
He's the only one I can love..."
You haven't changed. No, perhaps you've grown a little taller?"
Tix: "Yes. My brother told me you were safe,
Cain: "Tix, I will explain the details later.
So will you trust me and come with me?
There is something I want your help with."
Cain: "Yes. I want you to come with me."
Cain: "Tix, is there a place for you here?
The ministers of this country have always placed their hopes in Rayfon and Lodis,
All they asked was that you stay out of your brothers' way
and not disgrace the royal name...
You are a person in your own right.
You don't exist for someone else's sake..."
But it could be dangerous if you don't get treatment quickly..."
But... There is no place for me here..."
Prince... It is nearly time... Your Highness?
Huh? Where has he gone...? Your Highness?"
